title: Array-Vector Add
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Array_Vector_Add.md
text: 沿指定维度将向量添加到数组，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式；{Add along dimension} 指定沿其添加的维度、{Vector (V) source} 指定向量 V 的来源、{Vector (V)} 指定要添加的向量、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 输出最小值、{Output Maximum} 输出最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: A
ports.summary: 输入数组 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 输出 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Add along dimension
params.values: 沿其添加的维度 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Vector (V) source
params.values: 向量 V 的来源 Input port (default) | Dialog parameter

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Inherit same as first input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
